notes: عمن سمع: an unnamed hearer of Abu Jafar (rule 8).
Abu Jafar is the Imam heard (سمع X يقول, owner ruling 2); the story of al-Hasan's death is his account.
Al-Hasan speaks the saying (فقال عليه السلام إنما ابكى), so he is the last link inside the narrated account (rule 6); if the owner reads the chain as ending at Abu Jafar, drop the last level.
قيل له is the crowd in the scene, not links.
